output.review_comment:
The PR correctly fixes the implementation and makes all tests pass. However, the docstring is misleading. It describes pure graduated pricing ("every unit is charged at the price of the tier that its own position falls in"), but the implementation now applies bulk pricing: when quantity exceeds the last bounded tier, all units are charged at the unbounded tier price instead of per-tier pricing.

For example, with test_bulk_order(600, STANDARD_TIERS), the docstring suggests units 501-600 should cost 150¢ each (120,000¢ total), but the implementation returns 90,000¢ (all 600 units at 150¢). 

The docstring should be updated to document this bulk pricing behavior, as it's now a core part of the API contract. The changes to the core logic are correct and align with the pricing spec the tests encode.
